The bookmark HTML test fixtures contained in this directory:
- empty_folder.html
- epiphany.html
- firefox2.html
- firefox23.html
- firefox_bookmark_keyword.html
- ie_sans_charset.html
- redditsaver.html

These files are public test fixtures derived from Chromium and Mozilla browser
test suites used under public test fixture usage to verify Netscape Bookmark
HTML parser compatibility across browser versions and platforms.
